verdict.rationale: Brex's own materials describe coding spend as it happens. AI assistants write memos and fetch receipts, AI agents categorize spend instantly against policy, and the API auto-matches uploaded receipts to existing expenses. Brex also pitches closing the books in real time, with expense data synced automatically to accounting. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of merchant-level enrichment and GL/category mapping detail, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time coding quality (all evidence is vendor-claimed).
